messages:
Noah: Quick morning thought: if our favorite LLM ran the office coffee machine, what would the menu look like? :coffee:

Zara: Everything would be a prompt template. "Make me a latte" -> "intent: caffeinate; style: velvety; temperature: 63C; constraints: no oat." :laughing:

Diego: It would refuse to make drip unless you provided a proper system message first. "SYSTEM: user_prefers_drip=true"

Rin: And every cup has a confidence score on the napkin. "latte.confidence=0.87 (notes: extra foam)" :coffee_with_cream:

Noah: It'd also offer a debug view: ```[latte] tokens: 34 | beam=3 | rerank=on``` then apologize when foam != requested. :sweat_smile:

Zara: Lobbybot should run a poll. lobbybot: Which LLM-coffee trait would you adopt? 1) Prompt templates on the machine 2) Confidence napkins 3) Debug logs for orders 4) Mandatory system messages. Vote with 1-4.

Diego: Voting 2. I want my foam confidence.

Rin: Voting 1. Also can we add a "friendly reminder" mode where it suggests a pastry that pairs with your prompt? :croissant:
